metric: pg_ivm v1.16's view-maintenance workloads (inserts, updates and deletes after a view is created), run against the standard Dataform append pattern; each workload where that pattern drifts from a full refresh is refuted again, without the script, by a replayable counterexample.
caveats: Adapted, not the official tests: pg_ivm maintains views with its own engine, so each workload is re-run as a Dataform model that appends rows past MAX(load time) (the model is the same for every workload, chosen before running, so there is no per-case tuning). 1,069 workloads extracted, 336 after de-duplication, 110 adapted; 226 unsupported (216 use data-modifying CTEs, which apply several changes in one snapshot; 10 use CTEs, subqueries, DISTINCT or non-table sources). Of the 110, 100 drift on their script, 8 agree with it (not scored, no label), 2 could not be run. 95/100 at 20 seeds. Pinned to commit 22b4b45.
correctness: 0 false alarms: every counterexample is re-run from scratch in the simulator and diverges; no proof was given for a workload that drifts
